column1: # HOW TO FILL THIS IN: delete these # lines and the 3 example rows, then add your books below. Only Title is required.
# Title: the book title.   Author: the author (leave blank if unsure).
# Status (one of): read | reading | want to read | put aside | did not finish  (Chinese 已讀 / 在讀 / 想讀 / 暫停 / 未讀完 also work). If blank: a rating or Date Read means read, otherwise want to read.
# Feelings: words from the "How it felt" list, separated by ; (for example: Moving; Tender).   Review: anything you like.
